seoTitle: Add Google Calendar to Your Squarespace Site
metaDescription: Learn how to get a Google Calendar embed code and add it to a Squarespace page using a code block, so events update automatically.
intro: Embedding Google Calendar into a Squarespace site keeps visitors updated with real-time events, appointments, or class schedules without manual updates. This guide covers getting the embed code from Google Calendar and adding it to your Squarespace page.

steps.heading: Open Google Calendar settings
steps.body: In Google Calendar, click the gear icon and select Settings to access your calendar's sharing options.

steps.heading: Select the calendar to embed
steps.body: From the left-hand list, click the specific calendar you want to display, such as a business or class schedule.

steps.heading: Get the embed code
steps.body: Open Integrate Calendar and find the Embed Code section, where you can customize the calendar's appearance before copying the code.

steps.heading: Go to your Squarespace page
steps.body: Open the Squarespace page where you want the calendar to appear and click Edit.

steps.heading: Add a Code Block
steps.body: Click Add Block, choose Code Block, then click the pencil icon and paste the Google Calendar embed code.

steps.heading: Position the calendar
steps.body: Drag the block to place it wherever fits best on the page, and save your changes.

faq.question: Will my Squarespace calendar update automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, any updates you make in Google Calendar will automatically reflect on your Squarespace site once embedded.

faq.question: Can I embed multiple calendars on different pages?
faq.answer: Yes, you can embed multiple Google Calendars across different Squarespace pages using separate code blocks.

faq.question: What block do I use to embed the calendar?
faq.answer: You use a Code Block in Squarespace and paste the Google Calendar embed code into it.

faq.question: Can I customize how the calendar looks?
faq.answer: Yes, Google Calendar's Integrate Calendar section lets you customize the appearance before generating the embed code.

faq.question: Is this useful for public event calendars?
faq.answer: Yes, this method works well for creating a public event calendar or adding a calendar widget to your homepage.
